description: Transit Year-to-Date Ridership is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (datahub.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Year-to-date transit ridership data. Includes counts for SamTrans bus, paratransit, CalTrain, Shuttles, and the BART extension without the Daly City stop. SamTrans year-to-date data is reported in fiscal years that begin June 1 and end July 31 the next calendar year. This data is from 2011 to the present. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are train, bus, transit, public transportation. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: SamTrans. The portal shows 2019-06-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-smcgov-org-portal.
